jobs.occupation: Inetum - Solution Architect / Presales Lead (Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a senior Solution Architect and Presales Lead who combines deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O expertise with a strong commercial instinct and the ability to design winning, scalable solutions. In this role, you will be the technical and functional anchor during the Sales process - from opportunity identification to proposal and contract award - and will transition into the delivery phase as the solution authority ensuring architectural integrity throughout implementation.
Your responsibilities

• Solution architecture:

• Design holistic, scalable D365 F&O solutions that address complex business requirements across Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or other modules

• Define the overall solution blueprint including integrations, data migration strategy, security design and extension approach

• Ensure architectural decisions follow Microsoft best practices and align with client IT strategy

• Evaluate build vs. configure trade-offs and guide the use of ISV solutions where appropriate

• Maintain architectural oversight during delivery, resolving design conflicts and ensuring solution integrity

• Presales & business development:

• Lead RFP/RFI responses, coordinating cross-functional input to create compelling and commercially sound proposals

• Conduct discovery workshops and client demos to understand needs and position Inetum's D365 value proposition

• Create and present solution designs, implementation roadmaps and ROI analyses for client executives

• Collaborate with Sales teams to develop pricing, effort estimates and engagement models

• Build and maintain relationships with Microsoft account teams to identify and progress joint opportunities

• Client advisory:

• Act as a trusted advisor to CIO/CFO-level stakeholders on their ERP strategy and digital transformation roadmap

• Facilitate architecture review boards, technology assessments and solution validation workshops

• Guide clients on cloud transition, data strategy, and integration of D365 F&O with the broader Microsoft ecosystem (Azure, Power Platform, Teams)

• Practice development:

• Contribute to the development of Inetum's solution offerings, accelerators, and go-to-market assets for D365 F&O

• Define and promote architectural standards and patterns within the D365 practice

• Support capability development by mentoring senior consultants and sharing architectural expertise

• Represent Inetum at Microsoft events, community forums, and client roundtables

• Minimum 8 years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O or Dynamics AX, with at least 3 years in a Solution Architect or senior presales role

• Demonstrated ability to architect end-to-end D365 F&O solutions across multiple functional domains

• Strong knowledge of integration patterns (Dataverse, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, Data Entities) and data migration approaches

• Track record of winning complex ERP deals through high-quality presales and solution design

• Excellent executive presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft licensing models and commercial structures

• Fluent in English and Dutch or French

• Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance Functional Consultant Associate or higher is required

• Azure or Power Platform certifications are a strong plus

 

Nice to have:

• Experience in a Microsoft partner environment

• Knowledge of complementary ISV solutions in the D365 ecosystem

• Experience with Microsoft Fasttrack for Dynamics 365 programme

• Exposure to industry cloud solutions (e.g. Microsoft Cloud for Manufacturing, Financial Services)

• Proven experience leading or mentoring a team of consultants and/or developers

We're partnered with a large textiles business looking to expand with a new Scrum Master. As AI agents become active participants in the development process - writing, testing, and refactoring code alongside human engineers - the way teams plan, collaborate, and deliver is changing fast.

We are looking for a Scrum Master who thrives in that kind of shift: someone who can hold onto the core of what makes agile teams effective, while being genuinely curious and hands-on about reshaping it for a new way of working.

This isn't a role for someone looking to run ceremonies by the book. It's for someone who wants to help two teams, based in different countries, figure out together what agile looks like when part of the "team" doesn't sleep, doesn't take breaks, and works at a completely different rhythm than the humans around it.
What the role involves

• Facilitating the core Scrum ceremonies - sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives - across two geographically distributed teams, keeping collaboration strong despite the distance

• Rethinking familiar rituals for a new context: when AI agents are completing work continuously rather than in daily human blocks, what does a "daily stand-up" even MEAN? The successful candidate will help the team find out

• Guiding the team through new questions around estimation, velocity, and "done" - questions that don't have settled answers yet, given how differently AI-driven work behaves compared to traditional development

• Supporting developers through a real shift in their day-to-day role: from writing every line of code themselves to defining intent clearly, reviewing and validating what agents produce, and overseeing agentic workflows responsibly

• Building a culture where experimentation is normal and continuous improvement isn't just a retrospective exercise - because the tools and best practices in this space are moving quickly, and the team's process needs to move with them

• Clearing a path for the team by removing blockers, including ones unique to this environment: agent permissions and access, infrastructure limitations, or specification quality issues that trip up automated work

• Working closely with Product Ownership to make sure backlog items are written with enough clarity and testability that both human developers and AI agents can act on them without ambiguity

• Tracking delivery in a way that actually reflects reality - recognising that familiar metrics like story points or lines of code may not tell the full story anymore, and helping the team find better ones

• Building genuine trust and shared practice between the two country-based teams, so that both are working from the same playbook and learning from each other as agentic workflows evolve

• Solid, proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach within a software development environment - enterprise or B2B software experience is a strong plus

• Real, practical familiarity with agentic software development: AI systems that can autonomously plan, write, and test code, not just autocomplete-style tooling

• A clear grasp of how AI-assisted and AI-driven development is reshaping developer workflows, code review, testing, and quality practices

• Genuine comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving change, with a track record of adapting process pragmatically rather than defending a textbook framework for its own sake

• Strong facilitation, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills - the human side of this role matters just as much as the technical awareness

• A recognised Scrum Master certification, though the client sees this as a starting point rather than the full picture - this role asks for more than the standard curriculum covers

• Professional fluency in both Dutch and English

 

Nice to have:

• Direct experience working with AI coding agents or AI-augmented development pipelines in a live production setting

• A background in change management, especially leading teams through significant shifts in tooling or process

 

The kind of person you are (beyond the CV):

• A fast learner who gets genuinely excited by new technology rather than intimidated by it

• Hands-on and action-oriented - someone who leads by doing, not just directing from the sidelines

• A true team player who helps build a supportive, creative atmosphere for people navigating a lot of change

• Transparent and collaborative, comfortable working openly and respectfully across different teams, cultures, and time zones

• A natural leader - someone who can guide priorities and keep coordination tight across two teams without needing formal authority to do it

jobs.description:
Talencia is looking for a Business Intelligence Manager for one of its clients.

Location : Herstal (Liège)

Start date : ASAP

Duration : Full-time Open-Ended Contract (CDI)
Context 

For one ou my close partner, I'm currently recruiting for a Business Intelligence Manager position within a large Belgian organisation undergoing an important Data & BI transformation.

The role combines people management, BI strategy and hands-on involvement in the evolution of the organisation's Data & BI landscape
Description

• Lead and develop a team of BI professionals (circ. 5 people)

• Define and implement the BI roadmap and strategy

• Contribute to Data Governance, Data Quality and Data Management

• You will be directly reporting the the current Head of Data

What's in for you

• Company car (electric) with charging card

• Health and group insurance

• Up to 30 days of paid holidays

• Hybrid work model with 3 days remote

• Various bonuses and sectorial benefits

 

The position offers the opportunity to have a significant strategic impact on the organisation's Data & BI landscape, while managing a dedicated team.

In case of interest in this job, please send us your updated resume.

• 7+ years of experience in Business Intelligence / Data

• Strong knowledge of Power BI, SAP BusinessObjects and SQL

• Good understanding of Data Warehousing / Data Architecture

• Experience with Data Governance and Data Quality

• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication and change management skills

• Fluent in Dutch and/or French, with good knowledge of English

• Internet and mobile applications

• Business administration tools (pricing, contracts management, billing...)

• Electronic document management solutions (medical prescription, notarial deeds...)

• Intelligent apps...

Your tasks

• Provide technical analysis based on business requirements

• Take part in workload estimation

• Development of front end and/or back end applications

• Implement the developed solution

• Follow up on software lifecycle management: Continuous integration, release management, Unit testing, documentation, ...

• Keep up to date with new technologies and challenge yourself with experts

• Extensive experience in Java JEE development with frameworks/tools like Spring, Maven, Eclipse, Hibernate, NetBeans...

• You love to think about the business benefits of your developments

• You enjoy to write performing code and have a natural orientation toward quality

• You love to propose improvements to the rest of the team

• You love to challenge your ideas

• You master French or Dutch & English

Introduction
 

Our truck factory in Ghent is the largest Volvo Group truck factory worldwide. Every day, almost 3000 colleagues assemble top-quality trucks here. Innovation and continuous improvement are standard on our agenda, and that from day 1. We therefore firmly believe in the philosophy of Lean Manufacturing, in which attention to quality, safety and the environment are our top priority. Our site today has many different departments, but we all have one thing in common: passion for what we do. 
 

Meet your team
 

You will join a team of engineers who work both independently and in a team. Together we support each other to give the customer a qualitative and feasible solution to meet the desired truck specifications.
 

Your ideal job?
 

On our assembly line and in the Market Adaptation Center, all requests for a customized truck are handled according to the following principle: Our customer? He is king. Do you have good technical insight and would you like to take on the challenge with us to support the customer in the design of the ideal truck?
 

Your tasks:
 
 

• Investigate and answer customer questions about technical concepts that are not offered as a standard. This in terms of technical feasibility, cost price, lead time & legal compliance.  

• Advising other departments on technical product solutions to adapt standard trucks to customer demand. In doing so, you make decisions independently and take final responsibility for these concepts. 

• You ensure optimal coordination and cooperation between various parties involved (design, order planning, suppliers, sales engineers) so that the production of the designs is ensured efficiently and on time. 

• Continuously polish your technical knowledge & keep your product knowledge up-to-date 

Who are you?
 
 

• Minimum bachelor's degree, preferably in a technical field. Additional knowledge in economics can be an added value. Technical knowledge related to vehicles and/or knowledge of the automotive industry is an advantage. 

• Being able to work in a team is a must. You easily make contacts and maintain good relationships with others. 

• Be administrative, organizational, and commercially skilled. 

• Have excellent networking skills. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office. 

• Good knowledge of English is a requirement (other languages are an advantage).

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business  

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Czech and Polish.

Introduction
 

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.
 

This is us, your new colleagues
 

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.
 

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.
 

This is the job
 
 

• Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind. 

• Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress. 

• A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box. 

• Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?
 
 

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German. French is an asset.
